en.name: Leviathan
en.ability: If more than 1 good player is executed, evil wins. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.
en.flavor: To the last, I grapple with thee. From Hell’s heart, I stab at thee. For hate’s sake, I spit my last breath at thee.
